UPDATE ks_sessions SET status = 'collecting', content_idea = NULL WHERE session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM ks_sessions WHERE phone = '{{ $("Merge Context").first().json.from }}' AND status IN ('open','collecting') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1);

-- Get session info + all offers (LEFT JOIN so we get content_idea even with no images)
SELECT o.image_url, o.caption, s.content_idea, s.session_id
FROM ks_sessions s
LEFT JOIN ks_offers o ON o.session_id = s.session_id
WHERE s.phone = '{{ $("Merge Context").first().json.from }}'
  AND s.status = 'collecting'
ORDER BY o.added_at ASC NULLS FIRST;

const rows = $input.all().map(o => o.json);
const ctx = $('Merge Context').first().json;

if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
  throw new Error('No session found for ' + ctx.from);
}

// Content idea from session
const contentIdea = rows[0]?.content_idea || '';

// Only rows with actual offers/images
const offers = rows.filter(o => o.image_url || o.caption);

// Build EXACT user offer details (highest priority)
const offerLines = offers.length > 0
  ? offers.map((o, i) => {
      if (o.caption && o.image_url) {
        return `PRODUCT/OFFER ${i + 1}: ${o.caption} [WITH PRODUCT IMAGE]`;
      }

      if (o.caption) {
        return `OFFER TEXT ${i + 1}: ${o.caption}`;
      }

      return `PRODUCT IMAGE ${i + 1}: Product image only`;
    }).join('\n\n')
  : '(No specific offer details provided)';

// Collect all image URLs
const imageUrls = offers
  .filter(o => o.image_url)
  .map(o => o.image_url);

const primaryImage = imageUrls[0] || null;

const themeSection = contentIdea
  ? `
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 CONTENT THEME (SECONDARY)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

${contentIdea}

Use this ONLY as:
- mood inspiration
- styling direction
- emotional tone

DO NOT override the user's actual offer text.
`
  : '';

// MASTER PROMPT

UPDATE ks_sessions
SET content_idea = '{{ $json.planText.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
WHERE phone = '{{ $json.from }}'
  AND status NOT IN ('closed', 'skip')
  AND created_at = (
    SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM ks_sessions
    WHERE phone = '{{ $json.from }}'
    AND status NOT IN ('closed', 'skip')

UPDATE ks_sessions
SET status = 'collecting'
WHERE session_id = (

    AND status NOT IN ('closed', 'skip')
  ORDER BY created_at DESC

);

NEVER suggest, invent, or mention any specific price, discount percentage, cashback amount, or deal number (e.g. do NOT write '₹999', '10% off', '₹2000 cashback', 'flat 20% discount'). You have NO knowledge of what Kapoor & Sons is currently selling or at what price. Pricing and offers are ONLY decided by the shop owner. Your job is to suggest themes, captions, and timing — NOT to make up discounts or prices.

RESEARCH STEPS — Use your search tools:
1. Search 'trending electronics India [current month]' for what products are hot right now

3. If a festival is nearby, search '[festival] electronics marketing India' for creative inspiration
4. Search 'best posting time Instagram India [day of week]' for optimal timing

AFTER RESEARCHING, provide ONE content idea for TODAY with:

6. DESIGN DIRECTION — Specific color palette, mood, visual elements, Hindi text accents for the poster
   (Light/airy palette preferred: ivory white, royal blue, warm gold — Indian premium brand aesthetic)

Keep it actionable and authentic for a trusted local electronics shop in Betul, MP.
